newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Aug 19.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Front page article on success of new operational mechanism of enterprises in eastern coastal areas.
- Total sugarcane harvest in Guangxi hits 28.3 million tonnes in the 1996/1997 refinery season, producing 2.3655 million tonnes of sugar.
- Revenue from personal income tax totals 12.3 billion yuan for first half, rising 42.5 percent year-on-year.
- Sichuan province prohibits production of toy guns.

- Standing Committee of National People's Congress scheduled to meet August 25-29 to review and discuss a package of draft laws and resolutions on flood prevention, prices, and reducing damage from earthquakes.
CHINA SECURITIES
- Report by Economic Research Institute of State Planning Commission calls for faster pace in state sector mergers and bankruptcies to curb overproduction.
- Outstanding deposits of Beijing Urban Cooperative Bank hit 28.93 billion yuan at end-June.
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Value of state assets hit 6.589 trillion at end-1996, up 15.4 percent from the year-ago period.
- Tibetan temple runs shops, restaurants and other enterprises to boost income.
CHINA BUSINESS TIMES
- Kidnapping ring cracked in Liuzhou city and 17 children rescued.
- Foreign-funded firms export $67.21 billion in first half, 46.7 percent of total national exports.
CHINA CHEMICAL INDUSTRY NEWS
- Net profits of China's chemical industry up 602 million yuan in first half
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- One hundred ministers call for a ban on smoking in public places.
- Guangxi region invests around 180 billion yuan in infrastructure improvement.
- Chinese scientists discover natural breeding area of Tibetan antelopes for first time.
PROCURATORIAL DAILY
- Three officials in Ningbo, Zhejiang province, sentenced to life imprisonment for taking bribes.
FARMERS DAILY
- Beef cattle increase 14.6 percent year-on-year to 17.96 million in the first half, and mutton sheep increase 12.7 percent to 84.87 million head.
CHINA SPORTS DAILY
- Information on the Eighth National games is placed on the Internet
- Athletics coach Ma Junren takes athletes to Qinghai province for training on high plateau.
GUANGMING DAILY
- China now has 300 million male smokers and 20 million female smokers.
CHINA DAILY
- China's revenue from industrial and commercial tax up 19.1 percent year-on-year in July to reach 65.304 billion yuan.
